elements.text: Adapt the starter checks to the API domain before treating coverage as a release decision.

notes:
APIOps introduction. Technical continuation is illustrative; no client implementation or measured improvement is claimed.

Direct implementation review: checkExamplesPassValidation returns hasAnyExample(spec); checkValidationWorkflowPresent checks file existence; checkOpaqueIdentifiers looks for productId, variantId and categoryId; normalizeStatus returns manual defaultStatus or partial. These limitations are concrete in the inspected local create-apiops 1.1.4 template. The canonical JSON style guide is guidance and linked audit metadata; it is not automatically compiled into a complete Spectral ruleset. Review and extend automation rather than interpreting report generation as verified readiness.
